Following today’s “Surprise and Shine” event, Apple has now updated its official Design Resources portal with new product bezels for the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro. Here are the details.

iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro bezels now available

Designers are probably familiar with the Apple Design Resources portal, which features hardware and software assets that they can use in their own work.

That includes Figma, Sketch, Photoshop, PDF, PNG, and SVG assets for Apple platforms, products, and technologies, as well as fonts, SF Symbols, Apple’s Icon Composer, and badges and logos for services such as Apple Health, Apple Wallet, and more.

Following today’s announcement of the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro, Apple has updated its Design Resources portal with Photoshop and PNG assets for the new devices.

These include assets showing the iPhone Duo in both its open and closed configurations and in both available colors, as well as iPhone 18 Pro variants featuring its smaller Dynamic Island.

To check out the new bezels alongside the other assets currently available on the Apple Design Resources portal, follow this link.
